summary: Complete saved listing snapshots include cadastral lots, persisted active/inactive document requirements, pricing, status, hold details and relevant cancellation/account values. Changed fields are the default comparison, with optional full forms and explicit unavailable historical values.

Every new individual operation creates one review. Every new bulk listing operation creates one parent review and, when required, one exact-payload Head approval. Existing bulk batch/row history is reused.

Batch rows use server pagination, search, changed-field filtering, sorting and individual results. Clean rows stay accepted; reported rows receive their own linked correction case. Pending rows prevent batch completion.

Head, Auditor and administrator workspaces have separate role tabs and compact counts. Review Center internal notification controls were removed; the main Notifications module and notification services remain available.

Assigned System Admin and Super Admin corrections require a reason, preserve original evidence, and submit the same case for independent Auditor verification. Failed verification returns that case; earlier attempts remain readable.
Controlled payment correction accepts matching Review ID and Audit Case ID together and enforces assignment, payment/project binding and existing verification permissions.

SOA installments show Remaining Due using existing scheduled totals and allocated payments. Commission details show actual Released cash as a percentage of total entitlement, excluding pending/eligible/unreleased retention.

Main System and project layouts show module breadcrumbs. HR kiosk regeneration locks all devices, stores only a bcrypt hash, displays the new password once for 15 seconds, and enforces server-side expiry after 14 days.
Audit-log schema initialization moved to startup so logging cannot implicitly commit a caller transaction. Batch writes, reviews, cases, histories, notifications and audit logs roll back together.

The existing Attendance bulk timeout adjustment continues to preserve Time In, isolate selected employees, recalculate eligible draft payroll and preserve finalized payroll and the 6 PM automatic timeout setting.

migrationRequirements.effect: Adds parent/row review and case relationships, batch submission uniqueness, per-row decisions and returned protected approval status. Existing records and snapshots are retained.

migrationRequirements.apply: Once, before deploying the updated HR API and UI
migrationRequirements.effect: Adds hashed kiosk credential, generation, server expiry and rotation time to existing HR settings. The existing environment PIN works until the first rotation.

notes: Existing workflow view, department approval/return, audit review, case creation, system correction and final correction-verification permissions remain enforced on the backend.
System Admin and Super Admin share operational correction authority; explicit case assignment still applies. Only Super Admin can create/manage System Admin accounts.
Kiosk status and regeneration reuse the existing ATTENDANCE_MANAGE permission. Unauthenticated and viewer requests are denied.

validation.database: Disposable MySQL at 127.0.0.1:13307. Every mutating test verifies the port and exact workspace QA data directory first. Synthetic fixtures and test credentials only.

keyApiScenarios: Real 60- and 150-listing operations produce one parent each, exact immutable row evidence and individual audit logs.
58 clean rows plus 2 reported issues create exactly 2 cases; incomplete batches cannot close.
Concurrent identical bulk confirmations save once; concurrent identical protected submissions reuse one approval.
A failed correction returns to the same assigned case, retains both correction attempts, and closes only after independent verification.
An administrator cannot verify a correction; an Auditor without final verification permission is also denied.
Assigned Super Admin corrects a payment with both case/review IDs; unassigned owner, wrong review, missing reason and Auditor financial edit are denied.
Injected failure after two listing writes, after one row decision, and after child-case creation rolls back all affected data and evidence.
SOA returns exactly 67,638.84 for 108,819.42 scheduled less 41,180.58 allocated.
Rotating the kiosk password revokes three existing device sessions, rejects old credentials and the legacy PIN, hides plaintext from subsequent GET/audit data, and enforces expiry on the server.
Attendance tests preserve the 6 PM automatic timeout, Time In and finalized payroll; rollback failures and concurrent confirmation are covered.

remainingLimitations: No automatic deployment or production database writes were performed. Production Render cold-start behavior still requires verification after deployment.
Missing original historical values remain unavailable. Existing historical per-listing bulk reviews are preserved; new bulk operations use parent batching.

migrationCompatibilityFix.cause: TiDB validates references against the table schema before a multi-change ALTER. The original migration referenced a new column from a constraint in the same statement.
migrationCompatibilityFix.change: Separate column, index and foreign-key statements. Each change checks information_schema first. No stored procedures, data rewrites or foreign-key-check bypasses.
